name: Minds 3: memory span and wealth advantage, recall belief
description: The mean wealth advantage of rememberers over everyone else on mem-open's open sugarscape (walking, half of newborns remembering) against memory span 10, 25, 50, 100, 200 or 400 ticks, believing a remembered site's sugar as it was last seen (recall), at growback rate 0.25, 0.5 or 1. Seeds 1–20, ticks 500, measured over ticks 200–500.
